(1) the brain activity within the action representation system is specifically reduced for negative compared to affirmative action-related sentences, and (2) this modulation is accompanied by a reduction of the functional integration within this action representation system.
(i) sentential negation deactivates cortical areas and the pallidum; and (ii) sentential negations reduce functional integration of the action-representation network.
